Privacy Policy

This is a working draft prepared for the owner’s legal review before launch.

What we collect

We collect the name, phone number and address needed to fulfil and deliver your order, along with the details you enter to personalize the product — such as your child’s name, age and requested character — and the child’s photo you upload.

Why we collect your child’s photo

We use the photo for one purpose only: designing the product you ordered. It is not used for anything else.

How it is stored and who can access it

Children’s photos are held in private storage that is not publicly accessible, and can be reached only by the Ya 7kayti team in order to fulfil the order.

When it is deleted

Your child’s photo is deleted from our systems after the order is complete. Photos uploaded without an order being placed are deleted automatically after a short period.

Marketing is entirely separate

Uploading your child’s photo to fulfil an order is not consent to publish it. We never publish a child’s photo on our site or accounts without separate, explicit permission from you.

Privacy questions

You can reach us through the channels listed on our Contact page with any question about your data, or to request its deletion.
